basis: Current saved public sources and actual study records; no participant measurements inferred.

mixed_first_source_review.scope: Frozen mixed-source candidate classification and component relevance; no full temporal-answer gold standard.

pre_reconciliation_agreement.interpretation: Descriptive agreement of the supplied source-assisted personal judgments, computed before reconciliation.

mixed_personal_relation_reconciliation.method: Exact frozen source review under the existing named-entity and fragment-rejection policy.

personal_adjudicator_signoff.scope: Both reviewers jointly endorse the reconciled source_review_final_label values. This is adjudication of the assisted relation review, not independent paired annotation and not Cohen kappa eligibility.

job_archive_followup.scope: Additional snapshots extend existing company history; they do not increase the number of companies with historical coverage or establish completed hires.

agreement.method: Two separately saved source reviews; independence is reviewer self-reported, not externally verified.

pairwise_agreement.method: Two separately saved source reviews; independence is reviewer self-reported, not externally verified.

direct_review_collection.scope: Direct source decisions, independence self-reported; assisted worksheets and source supplements are separate.

pairwise_agreement.method: Two separately saved source reviews; independence is reviewer self-reported, not externally verified.

direct_review_collection.scope: Direct source decisions, independence self-reported; assisted worksheets and source supplements are separate.

second_task_key_review.scope: Compare and adjudicate before final grading; this is not entity/relation agreement.

paired_condition_descriptives.interpretation: Observed within-participant differences only. Different task sets, shared state language and five participants do not establish a causal treatment effect.

limits: Observed task responses are not pooled votes on one common question.
Elapsed times include interruptions; they do not establish active attention.
Condition summaries and paired descriptive differences do not establish a causal treatment effect.
Free-text explanations were not collected. Rubric criteria requiring an explanation cannot be inferred from the action selector.
Final state accuracy concerns participant judgments; unmeasured criteria and causal pilot effects are not inferred.

remaining: Complete official-population histories remain unavailable for 3 of 18 companies. Four additional scoped channels are available; CrewAI has historical advertisements but no complete board baseline. Weekly hiring trajectories remain unestablished.
pilot_measurement_limitations: Free-text evidence and qualifying/policy explanations were not collected; unassessable criteria remain explicitly unmeasured.
